_readme: Edit price, stock, description, and color. Keep the shirt IDs exactly as they are. stock = quantity left; 0 means sold out.

HW-001.description: A washed olive tee with a small chest mark and a hazy desert road scene on the back. Power lines, palm trees, and a masked figure fade into the hem, making the print feel part of the fabric.

HW-002.description: A heavyweight black tee with a small silver spider on the chest and a torn web climbing the hem. Katakana lettering runs down the side, while a full illustrated hero swings through the web on the back.

HW-003.description: A deep plum tee for late nights, with a quiet chest wordmark and woven-style hem tag. The back features a neon street scene with coordinates and the line “late nights, bright lights.”
